notes:
First version: a turn-based trail-bike arena game for Foundry v14, written with Starfinder 2e in mind.

  • Every rider locks in a steer, a gear and an optional boost, then all bikes run at once.
  • Arena builder with five layouts, teams or everyone for themselves, and autopilot riders at three difficulties.
  • Piloting checks each round for spare spaces, and at each crash to swerve.
